defect: registered stream handshake is supplied by an unspecified register implementation
rationale: REG_TYPE selects bypass, simple-buffer, or skid-buffer behavior, but the selected register implementation is an empty stub. Its latency, backpressure, and output drive are not specified, so the stream contract cannot be decided.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the register interface and retained the source REG_TYPE parameter while making the implementation an explicit black box.

mutation.description: The selected AXI stream register implementation and its handshake behavior are intentionally omitted.
